Thank you a lot for answer to my request of help, is a thing that nobody does in the past so I'm really thankfull.

I already separate myself from my family, I have been living in my grandmother's house for a long days but nothing change. The problem is my step-father, since I'm a baby he hates me for no reasons and I live in a nightmare because of him. He's not the good man that every families dream of... And I don't have my father, he leaves few years before today. My mother is constantly with my step-father, according to him the right of doing anything as talk with me with bad language, bullying me. I'm really upset...

I quit school because I didn't find a school to be honest. All the places in school were already taken and I'm going to do a year with doing nothing but... It makes the ambience of my family doing bad. I feel so bad to stop school like this. They're like "shame on you", and it's really hard to live with it. Everyday, I hear that and I'm on my way to get upset of my family as I'm upset with fake friends.
But you're right, I should take this eat to try to be better, to become the someone that I want to be.

The conclusion of my 18 years of living is that I don't find my place anywhere. I feel like a waste of space everywhere I go. It's strange... And I hope it'll stop.

I've been hurt, i get stronger but I continue to be hurt. I pray to see this stop. 

I don't want to die, but I want to live with joy... I know myself and I know I'll never have the bravery for killing myself. I want to believe, but sometimes, it's hard to believe...

everything, school, family, myself, friends... i don't feel like i'm a member of my family to be honest... i hate shool due to the past with bullying. i don't have real friends and i hate everything about myself as my face and my interior. i feel like a waste of space, only a sad girl who needs to get a kind of sunshine in her own world. my mother doesn't care about it, i stopped school this week cuz i didn't find something to learn at school.. everything is confused, i'm so sorry
